summary.text: Jumelle Brooks is the Democratic candidate for the South Carolina House of Representatives, District 12, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where incumbent Daniel Gibson (R) is also on the ballot.
Brooks also ran in the 2024 general election for the same seat.

paragraphs.text: Brooks was the Democratic candidate for South Carolina House District 12 in 2024, when incumbent Daniel Gibson (R) won the general election with 52.3% of the vote to her 47.7%.
She advanced from the Democratic primary without appearing on the ballot after the June 9, 2026 primary was canceled.
